local_changes: Separate YouTube and iOS YouTube Music dispatch by User-Agent; guard HTTP status, body type/size, routes and completion.
Force YouTube captionLang=off; hide Shorts/create by default and retain Music Samples.
Preserve server bitrate/codec/quality assignments when merging Spotify configuration, and retain unspecified server flags.
Omit unsafe Spotify search byte-scanner and unverified player/ad_break/download-setting rewrites.
Bundle the pinned source files; no additional JavaScript download at runtime.
Select the YouTube decoder from the endpoint path without query values.
Bound outgoing request bodies; normalize unambiguous User-Agent headers and reject unrelated client identifiers.
Treat JSON null/array options as defaults instead of disabling processing.
Compact static Spotify data tables without an npm dependency; include the module in checksum coverage.
